title: AI tool provides balanced feedback from five advisors plus a #AI #Productivity #DecisionMaking
description:
This product presents an enhanced decision-making tool built on top of Claude, an AI known for overly agreeable responses. The innovation lies in a “council” feature that generates five distinct AI personas, each evaluating a given idea from different perspectives, including skepticism, problem identification, potential benefits, and overlooked details. A final summarizing persona integrates these viewpoints to deliver a balanced answer and practical next step. The core insight addresses the limitation of single-response AI tools that tend to affirm any input, undermining their reliability for critical decisions. By simulating a diverse advisory panel through multiple AI agents, users receive a more nuanced and thorough analysis. This approach increases trust in AI-assisted judgment and supports more informed decision-making. The concept’s viral potential stems from its clever framing of internal debate, which feels relatable and enhances engagement. It also offers clear consumer value by reducing bias and providing structured feedback, appealing to innovators, entrepreneurs, and anyone facing complex choices. #AI #DecisionMaking #ClaudeAI
